title: Anthropic plans fund for workers threatened by AI, Musk counters with SpaceX shares for children
text:
Anthropic wants to put five percent of its shares into a new public benefit fund that will also look into direct payments to workers at risk of losing their jobs. The fund is a company-owned LLC, so Anthropic keeps control of it as a possible IPO approaches. By offering the option of direct payments, Anthropic goes further than its competitors. Elon Musk says on X the company should just give the shares directly to the public.
The article Anthropic plans fund for workers threatened by AI, Musk counters with SpaceX shares for children appeared first on The Decoder.
